## Requirements (contract)

1. **Batch selection** — a small first batch from the P32.11 ranked queue after P31
   reconciliation, prioritizing dossier missing relationships and independent evidence
   lineage; ceilings enforced (≤2 incremental non-portfolio families, ≤10 approved
   documents/aggregate rows per family, ≤2 new protocol families, ≤5 total families
   including the three pilot cities); rejected alternatives documented; SRC-027 outside
   the acquired batch.
2. **Gate packets** — exact gate packets for each bounded live slice (no approval
   references exist); every slice carries a real approval ref or an explicit OPEN
   return-pass row; fixture success never closes a live outcome.
3. **Funnel + maintenance burden** — discovery → qualification → approval → capture →
   extraction → link/relationship support → publication eligibility, plus per-family
   maintenance burden (protocol/target counts, refresh cadence, owner, retry budget,
   blocked/error handling); fixture measurements labelled, never relabelled as live or
   as measured minutes.
4. **Recommendations** — continue/stop/improve per family on unique supported gap
   closure + cost; expansion beyond the batch = a new scope decision; descriptive only
   (no matched comparison run).
5. **Matched comparison** — the preregistered S5 matched discovery comparison is
   optional; it was NOT run — all results labelled descriptive only.

## Plan → landed

**New module `tasks/src/tasks/acquisition_pilot.py`** — the second acquisition stage on
the P32.11 reviewed queue (`tasks.acquisition`):

- **`select_batch` (`acq-pilot-select/1`)** — deterministic five-family batch under the
  live-stage ceilings: the three pilot-city dossier families fill the portfolio slot
  verbatim (P-SEL-1 — measured, never re-selected); two incremental slots are filled by
  rank order, one contract/acquisition-chain family (P-SEL-2 → **oklahoma-state**:
  SRC-006 OMES statewide contracts + SRC-007 DAC UVED P0-dossier authority chain,
  in-family award members SRC-008/SRC-009 excluded — no recorded award gap) and one
  independent-oversight family (P-SEL-3 → **california-state-auditor**: SRC-011, the
  only non-municipal provenance class in the inventory). Every other candidate carries
  a recorded `RejectedAlternative` (`portfolio_member`, `p31_owned`, `duplicate`,
  `blocked`, `prohibited_metadata_only`, `preflight_screening_owed`,
  `no_recorded_award_gap`, `outside_pilot_shapes`, `capacity`). **SRC-027** stays
  metadata-only outside the acquired batch by construction and by check.
- **`family_funnel` (`acq-pilot-funnel/1`)** — the seven-stage funnel (discovery →
  candidate_qualification → approval_gate → capture → extraction → link_support →
  publication_eligibility) + maintenance burden per family, measured from the
  committed dossier packets/dossiers/return passes only: offline-replay counts are
  labelled `offline_replay`, `captured_live` is 0 everywhere, `measured_minutes` is
  never fabricated (None), and burden distinguishes one-time setup (estimate),
  recurring maintenance (refresh cadence + owner) and measured cost (none). Failed,
  403, blocked, screening-owed, prohibited and rights-undetermined targets stay
  visible with reasons, retry budget (2/target) and escalation path.
- **`gap_ledger` (`acq-pilot-gap-ledger/1`)** — before/after reconciliation at fact
  granularity ((slug, predicate, raw value) → asserting source families): unique vs
  shared support partitioned per family; `double_counted=0`,
  `mirror_as_independent=0`, `p31_duplicate_onboarding=0`; incremental families are
  `pending_live` — expectations are never counted as closures.
- **`return_pass_packet` (`sig.acq-pilot-return-pass/1`)** — the exact gate packets for
  the two incremental bounded live slices: per-target URLs/goals, ≤10-document cap,
  html_text/pdf_text only (0 new protocol families), retry budget, HG-03 + Part VIII +
  municipal-publication preconditions, explicit non-goals (no rights flip, no gate
  completion, no request sent, no spend, no publication, no crawler, no
  workbook/row-level transport), `approval_refs=[]` — none exist and none is
  fabricated — pinned to OPEN **D-P32.21-1**; portfolio slices stay pinned to
  D-P32.18-1 / D-P32.19-1 / D-P32.20-1.
- **`recommend`** — per-family continue/stop/improve on unique supported gap closure +
  cost: okc **continue** (34/36 release-valid, 14 unique assertions), tulsa
  **improve** (honest 24/36 partial — the contract-chain gate stays unresolved),
  san-diego **continue** (29/36 mechanical-complete, review not run), both
  incrementals **continue** under recorded conditions + stop rules. Every verdict
  carries basis, unique closure, cost basis, continue-conditions and stop-conditions;
  expansion beyond the batch is a new scope decision.
- **`check_pilot`** — the fail-closed CI invariants (also `sig-tasks acquisition
  pilot-check`): ceilings, SRC-027 exclusion, P31/mirror exclusion, `captured_live=0`,
  `measured_minutes=None`, `prepared_not_executed`, no approval refs, descriptive-only
  label, and **the named deferrals must exist as OPEN rows in the committed
  DEFERRALS.md** — a gate packet whose deferral isn't registered fails.

**Committed readout** — `docs/build/reports/p32.21-acquisition-pilot/` (BATCH.json,
FUNNEL.json, GAP_LEDGER.json, ACQ_PILOT_RETURN_PASS.json, READOUT.json, READOUT.md;
deterministic — `test_readout_is_deterministic`).

**CLI** — additive `sig-tasks acquisition pilot [--json] [--out DIR]` and
`acquisition pilot-check`.
